transcript.text: I need to flag something important before we go further with the NimbusMQ recommendation. This morning, while helping another team investigate a load-test harness, I confirmed that the production burst requirement is actually 35,000 events per second — not the 20,000 we tested in staging. NimbusMQ throttles at 25,000 events per second, while StreamForge supports up to 40,000. I haven't updated the architecture document yet because the harness investigation was a separate task, but this directly impacts our service selection.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical procurement issue. I received the latest data-processing terms from our legal review just an hour ago: EU customer audit events must be stored in an EU region, and only StreamForge offers the required EU region under the shortlisted contracts. The StreamForge agreement needs a data-residency review commitment. I haven't attached these terms to the architecture review yet, but given the pipeline will process events from EU customers, this is a hard constraint that affects the NimbusMQ recommendation.
